legal_design_anchors.gdpr_article_11: Do not acquire, maintain or process additional identifying information solely to identify a data subject when identification is not required for the research purpose; where the controller can demonstrate it cannot identify the data subject, rights that require identification are handled in accordance with Article 11 unless the data subject provides additional information enabling identification.
legal_design_anchors.gdpr_article_12: The controller must provide transparent information and facilitate exercise of data-subject rights through the approved privacy contact and procedure.
legal_design_anchors.gdpr_article_15: The right of access includes confirmation whether personal data are processed, access to the personal data, a copy of the personal data undergoing processing and the contextual information required by Article 15. The reference adapter implements only the receipt-keyed respondent-record-copy component; requester authentication, confirmation and the controller-supplied processing context remain operational/controller responsibilities.
legal_design_anchors.gdpr_article_16: Where a live response can be located by the opaque receipt and preset analytical values are inaccurate, rectification must be possible without introducing direct identifiers or mutating technical/provenance fields.
legal_design_anchors.gdpr_article_18: Where restriction applies, the record must not continue through ordinary analytical processing while the restriction is active.
legal_design_anchors.gdpr_article_20: Data portability applies only where the processing is based on consent or contract, is carried out by automated means and concerns data provided by the data subject. If legitimate interest is finally approved as proposed, Article 20 portability is not the applicable right for that processing; if the basis changes to consent or contract, a structured machine-readable portability path must be implemented and validated before collection.
legal_design_anchors.gdpr_article_21: Where processing relies on legitimate interests and a data subject objects, processing must stop while the controller assesses the objection unless a lawful continuation ground is established.

rights_applicability.decision_rule: The approved rights procedure and public notice must match the controller-approved final legal basis. A change of legal basis invalidates this applicability matrix until affected rights and operational paths are re-reviewed and validated.

identification_policy.technical_receipt: The submit route returns an opaque response_id not derived from name, email, IP, device, CRM or employer identity. If retained by the respondent it may locate the corresponding research-only record without creating an identity lookup table.
identification_policy.lost_receipt_rule: If the controller cannot otherwise identify the record, it must not create a new identity-linkage mechanism solely to satisfy lookup; Article 11 and any additional information voluntarily provided by the data subject must be assessed under the approved procedure.

request_channel.rule: No public collection until the determined controller publishes an operational privacy contact and request-handling route.

research_store_operations.lookup: Locate only by opaque response_id in the isolated research store; do not search CRM, optional-contact records, IP logs, user-agent logs or device data.
research_store_operations.access: After the controller applies the approved requester-authentication procedure, produce only the receipt-keyed copy of the respondent's own stored analytical record through the reviewed allowlist. Storage hashes, idempotency internals, hold state, replay controls and all other respondents are excluded.
research_store_operations.rectification: Locate by opaque response_id, revalidate only corrected preset profile/answer values against the frozen form definition, preserve technical/provenance fields, regenerate integrity metadata atomically and preserve active restriction/objection holds. A delayed retry of the original transport body must not overwrite the correction.
research_store_operations.erasure: Delete the analytical row, active analysis hold and idempotency receipt atomically from live research storage. A delayed retry must not recreate erased data. The PROD rights-control binding may retain only the opaque response_id plus technical expiry metadata as a non-analytical replay-suppression marker and must expire that marker no later than 24 hours after successful live erasure. The reference SQLite adapter remains TEST/REFERENCE only and does not authorize the PROD binding.
research_store_operations.erasure_replay_marker_prod_binding: PROD MUST USE PER-MARKER FINITE EXPIRY NOT LATER THAN ERASURE_PLUS_24H_AND AUTOMATIC PURGE; PROVIDER-BOUND TEST TWIN MUST PROVE EXPIRY
research_store_operations.restriction_or_objection: A receipt-keyed bounded analysis hold keeps the record available for rights review but excludes it from analytical export while active.
research_store_operations.portability: No separate portability export is enabled while the legal basis remains unresolved. If the controller selects consent or contract and Article 20 conditions are met, implement and validate a reviewed structured machine-readable export before PROD.

rights_case_logging.allowed: minimum case metadata needed to demonstrate handling, decision, dates and outcome
forbidden: copying questionnaire answers into the rights-case log
adding CRM/customer identifiers to analytical records
using a rights request to build an identity-to-response registry
copying rights-case narrative into the research analysis-hold table

backup_and_deletion.rule: Live erasure requires a timestamped deletion receipt and before/after counts. Replay suppression is non-analytical, capped at 24 hours after successful erasure and excluded from NF06/export. Provider backups may retain residual copies only for the validated pre-existing non-renewing rotation and must not silently restore deleted or held records into active analysis.

required_before_prod: rights applicability matrix reconciled to the final legal basis
privacy notice updated with final legal-basis-dependent rights
processor/subprocessor and provider logging/backup/deletion facts frozen
production research-only adapter supports receipt lookup, reviewed access copy, preset-value rectification, bounded analysis holds, atomic erasure and maximum-24-hour per-marker replay suppression
if Article 20 applies, a structured machine-readable portability path is implemented and provider-bound validated before collection
if consent becomes a legal basis, an operational withdrawal path is implemented before collection
controller approves requester authentication and the Article 15 confirmation/context response that supplements the reference data copy
controller accepts the maximum-24-hour replay-marker policy and any shorter live value used by the binding

provider-bound TEST TWIN proves access isolation, rectification stale-retry safety, held-record export exclusion, erasure anti-replay and automatic marker expiry within 24 hours; TEST TWIN remains NON_EVIDENCE
procedure approval reference and SHA-256 are frozen in the PROD activation manifest

test_twin.rule: Rights-flow tests use synthetic engineering fixtures only and cannot be cited as respondent evidence.
